name: health-search
description: Searches and retrieves patient clinical records from the Einstein Hospital EHR system (HStory). Returns structured patient data including conditions, active medications, recent visits and responsible physician.

tools.name: search_patient
tools.description: Searches for a patient by name and returns their full clinical profile including conditions, medications and responsible physician.

tools.name: get_medical_history
tools.description: Returns the complete medical history for a patient ID including past diagnoses, procedures, hospitalizations and lab results.

tools.name: get_prescriptions
tools.description: Returns active prescriptions for a patient including drug name, dosage, frequency and prescribing physician.
